content:
anya: Quick flag FYI: turned on adaptive-backoff for sse routing at 2% canary, saw an uptick in short reconnects for mobile SDKs at ~08:13.
tom: Adaptive backoff meaning we delay route swap when probe rate spikes?
anya: Yes, we added transient backoff so route doesn't flip for short bursts. But mobile clients with aggressive reconnect give up and open new conns, causing duplicate meter events.
ravi: Logs:
```
[08:13:12] routing: adaptive_backoff=on tenant=mobile-x probe_burst=high
[08:13:12] sse: conn=mob-12 close_reason=client_retry
[08:13:13] metering: event=conn_open tenant=mobile-x tag=[]
```
console-team: Our SSE reconnect sampling was set to 1% and missed the burst. I can bump to 10% for the affected tenant group for 20m.
tom: Proposal: (1) mark adaptive-backoff-induced fallthroughs with tag=backoff to prevent billing; (2) on route decision, if we see client-side immediate reconnect, emit metric sse.backoff_reconnects to catch SDK patterns; (3) add a short rollout UI note so PMs know SDKs might need backoff updates.
anya: Config sketch:
```
routing.adaptive_backoff.enabled=true
routing.adaptive_backoff.backoff_ms=250
routing.adaptive_backoff.annotate_tag=backoff
```
ravi: Important: metering will need to honor tag=backoff; otherwise tokens double-count. I'll open a small PR to filter backoff-tagged events in pipeline.
console-team: I'll add an alert: if sse.backoff_reconnects > 5/min during rollout -> notify infra. Also temporary sampling bump as noted.
ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: routing:adaptive-backoff -> canary 0.5% at 09:00.
anya: Action items: tom add tag propagation in routing code, ravi metering guard, console bump sampling + add alert, tom write SDK note for client teams. Reevaluate after 30m.
